page: Amazon Web Services i8g.metal-24xl is a storage-optimized bare-metal server powered by AWS Graviton Neoverse-V2 processors. Utilizing the arm64 architecture, this instance features 96 dedicated physical cores running at 2.8 GHz with a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of DDR5 memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 22,500 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The network interface delivers a baseline bandwidth of 56 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU tests and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top 10%. Memory performance is also highly competitive, achieving top-tier ratings in cached and uncached read/write bandwidth tests, including 481.52 GB/sec for large-block uncached reads. Database operations and Redis SET operations both rank in the top 10%, with Redis reaching 197.01 million operations per second. However, single-core performance remains in the average tier, as demonstrated by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core metrics.

The arm64 architecture and high-density local NVMe storage provide high resource density, making this bare-metal server a cost-efficient option for scale-out workloads compared to traditional x86 hardware. The combination of massive local storage, high memory bandwidth, and strong multi-threaded capabilities makes the i8g.metal-24xl highly suitable for large-scale databases, high-throughput Redis deployments, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing tasks.
